resolution: Clarification/confirmation of the same fix as req_2410/2411: the 'Edge · Move gizmo · 0 selected' flavor text did NOT die with the deleted root cart/modelview.tsx twin — it lived in the surviving editor copy cart/editor/stage/ModelView.tsx (the viewport title strip, line 684), which is exactly where I cut it. Verified it is the SOLE source of that visible string: the mesh toolbar (ToolOptions.tsx) renders icon buttons with hover-only tooltips, no printed status, so 'Edge'+'Move gizmo' were a literal restatement of the two highlighted toolbar icons sitting beside the text. Now the strip shows only what the icons can't: selection mode → 'N selected', view mode → tris. Also swept ToolOptions' remaining pills (SNAP/TOOL/FLOOR/SAFE/DETAIL) — those surface state not otherwise on screen, so they are legit readouts, not icon-restatements; nothing else to remove. Fix already committed c6b85b6dc; if a running editor still shows the old string it is a reload behind, the source no longer emits it.
